scheme_name: Old Age Homes | Official Website of Department of Social Welfare Uttar Pradesh, India.

1. History of the scheme: It started in 2015-2016. In each district, old age homes with a capacity of 150 elderly residents are run by voluntary organizations.
2. Objective of the scheme: Under this scheme, senior citizens above 60 years of age, who do not have sufficient resources for their own maintenance, or who are poor or destitute and are willing to live in the above mentioned ashrams, are provided complete facilities of free accommodation, food, clothing, medicine, entertainment, personal care material for each elderly inmate in the old age homes run on PPP model through voluntary organizations.
3. Benefits of the scheme: Under this scheme, complete facilities like free accommodation, food, clothing, medicine, entertainment and personal care material are provided to every elderly inmate in the old age homes run on PPP model through voluntary organizations.
4. Eligibility for the scheme: Age - Above 60 years. Social class - Senior citizens of all categories are eligible. Gender - Female/Male/Transgender. Special Criteria- Such elderly persons, who come in contact with the District Magistrate, Sub-District Magistrate, Police or District Social Welfare Officer from railway stations, bus stations etc. and who do not have any arrangement for boarding and lodging, besides this, if the Hon'ble MP, Hon'ble MLAs or any other eminent public representative recommends the admission of the elderly, then in such cases, with the consent of the District Magistrate, the District Social Welfare Officer gives permission to keep them in the old age home. Such elderly persons, if during the hearing of the applications for maintenance it comes to the notice of the constituted Tribunal that the heirs of the elderly persons who are providing maintenance do not want to keep them with them.
5. Admission Process:-: Applications will be invited from senior citizens at least twice each year. Applications can be submitted by senior citizens to the Block Development Office, District Social Welfare Officer Office, Municipal Corporation Office, Tehsil Collectorate, or the institution, but will ultimately be kept for record at the old age home. The notification, dated 20 October 2014, established a tribunal headed by the Sub-District Magistrate and an appellate tribunal headed by the District Magistrate. Therefore, it will be mandatory to admit eligible elderly persons recommended by the tribunal to the nursing home on a priority basis.

In addition to such elderly persons who come in contact with the District Magistrate, Sub-District Magistrate, Police or District Social Welfare Officer from railway stations, bus stations etc. and who do not have any arrangement for food and shelter, if a recommendation is made by the Hon'ble MP, Hon'ble MLAs or any other eminent public representative regarding the admission of the elderly, then in such cases, with the consent of the District Magistrate, the District Social Welfare Officer will grant permission to keep them in the old age home.
6. Application Process: Process to apply online Step 1: First of all, open https://oldagehome.upsdc.gov.in in the browser and click on "apply online." Step 2: On clicking, you will be presented with an online application form where you can fill in the details like name of the senior citizen, date of birth/age, height (cm), height, weight (kg), skin color, hair color, marital status, etc., and submit it by uploading the photo of the senior citizen. Step 3: After submission, the application form will be approved by the committee constituted under the chairmanship of the District Social Welfare Officer. Procedure to apply offline
You can get this application form through two main mediums:-
Official website of Vriddhashram Yojana https://oldagehome.upsdc.gov.in/ The form can be downloaded from here and its printed copy can be obtained.

From offices (free): From the office of the District Social Welfare Officer of the district where the old age home is located. From the development block office. From the Municipal Body Office (Municipality or Municipal Corporation). Directly from the organization running the old age home.
You can fill the above form and submit it along with all the required documents to any of the offices listed below.
District Social Welfare Officer Office. Block Development Office. Municipal body office. Directly to the organization running the old age home.
The status of the filled form can be tracked from the website.
Disclaimer- For more information visit the official website https://oldagehome.upsdc.gov.in Visit or contact the District Social Welfare Officer, Office.
